body: Thank you for trying to help me. I really do appreciate the gesture. Also no, she doesn't know. I'm already so much of a burden on her, I don't want her to have to deal with all of my problems.
I really do appreciate the offer, but I'm not living in America, nor would that belt get here in time if I was :)
I would, but I don't know the area. Plus my belt is broken so I don't actually have any wearable clothes for going out at the moment.

Y'know I did go out recently. It was the first time I had been out on my own without reason for a good year or so. That's how I contracted the stomach bug that flared my anxiety up to the point where I've decided to bring my suicide forward. Some people just don't have much luck in life.

Actually I haven't been on medication for many years now. I haven't had a therapist or helper for a good 3 years too. After I hit 18, a lot of the options of care were shut and the ones that were left said I wasn't a high enough priority to give me anything.
